protocol: Official April 8-21 train and April 22-28 validation split; no hidden-test outcomes; four user-ID-modulo folds for residual and gate selection; validation-slate gates use only identifiers, timestamps, and training-coverage attributes.

experiments.name: censored mixture-of-lognormals survival ranking
experiments.evidence: A three-component full-metadata DeepFM survival head reached 0.59077823 standalone. Residual fold weights were [0, 0, 0.005, 0]; the 0.61279035 fixed score was therefore unsupported by three folds.

experiments.name: mixture-survival auxiliary regularization
experiments.evidence: Weight 0.2 produced 0.60748172 standalone and 0.61276615 OOF; weight 0.02 produced 0.60716903 standalone and 0.61278379 OOF, but fold 1 regressed and the fixed recipe scored 0.61277413.

experiments.name: Kaplan-Meier-style threshold survival priors
experiments.evidence: A temporally trained 38-feature calibrator reached 0.59372330 standalone. Its nested OOF primary was 0.61278450 with only one nonzero fold. Among individual priors, type-at-risk density reached 0.61282837 fixed with both aggregate metrics higher, but held-out fold 0 lost 0.00002778; 124 duration interactions did not remove the instability.

experiments.name: duration-regime DeepFM experts
experiments.evidence: Shared-backbone short/medium/long experts selected residual weight 0.005 in every fold. Three-seed averaging improved standalone primary to 0.60820252 and fixed primary to 0.61280549, but fold 1 still lost 0.00002116. Label-free activity and training-coverage gates selected consistent weights yet retained a negative fold. Independent regime-specific categorical and numeric biases reached 0.61279142 OOF but had two negative folds.

successful_tracked_run_totals.note: The separate rank-averaging step used another 5.172 wall-seconds but did not emit a resource tracker record.

conclusion: Every survival and duration-regime candidate either selected zero residual weight in most folds or retained at least one held-out regression. No candidate met the repository's stable-gain acceptance rule, so the 0.6127808094 champion remains authoritative.
